mechanism: Probenecid inhibits renal tubular secretion of mycophenolic acid (MPA), the active metabolite of mycophenolate, leading to increased MPA concentrations and potential toxicity.
action: Monitor mycophenolate levels closely; consider mycophenolate dose reduction if used concurrently with probenecid, and assess for signs of mycophenolate toxicity (GI symptoms, hematologic abnormalities).
